headline: Scout baseline only; after not measured

provenance.selection: build_scout_dataset.py coco using only instances_val2017.json, default caps; all 107 downloaded images evaluated together as val
limitations: Stock YOLOv8n is pretrained on COCO; this is an in-distribution validation baseline, not room evaluation or fine-tuning improvement.
Scout weapon maps knife, scissors and baseball bat; this subset does not evaluate firearms.
Crowd annotations are excluded by the dataset builder.
